title: A planning update on an item the session doesn't hold moves the session's focus away from the item it holds
outcome: A planning update on an item the session doesn't hold moves the session's focus away from the item it holds
acceptance: An unclaimed planning update (block, unblock, revise, after/drop_after, supersede, cancel, add) on an item the session does not hold leaves the session's focus on its currently held item. The receipt says focus is unchanged.
When the session holds no item, the existing focus-selection behaviour and its receipt disclosure stay as they are today.
Tests cover: holding item X, then blocking or revising item Y, leaves focus on X with X's claim untouched; and with no held item, focus selection is unchanged.
